headline: Congress takes a pro forma breather as both chambers reconvene Monday for brief sessions.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on October 1, convening for just 35 seconds before adjourning until Monday. The Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee concluded hearings on four Trump administration nominees for Treasury, HUD, and Export-Import Bank positions.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on October 1 for just three minutes. Eighty public bills were introduced, along with one private bill and 17 resolutions. The chamber approved a committee report on H.R. 6993, legislation directing the VA to fund traumatic brain injury research programs.

committees.committee: Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
committees.topic: Nominations hearings for Treasury, HUD, and Export-Import Bank officials
